max_temperature.alert_message: Temperature above 30 °C causes cauliflower curd to become loose.
max_temperature.preventive_measure: Irrigate and use shade cloth.

min_humidity.alert_message: Humidity below 40% can cause cauliflower to bolt prematurely.

max_humidity.alert_message: Humidity above 85% raises rot and disease risk in cauliflower.
max_humidity.preventive_measure: Ensure air circulation.

min_rainfall.alert_message: Rainfall <10 mm may require irrigation for cauliflower.
min_rainfall.preventive_measure: Irrigate to maintain even soil moisture.

max_rainfall.alert_message: Rainfall >50 mm can waterlog cauliflower roots.
max_rainfall.preventive_measure: Ensure drainage.

max_uv_index.alert_message: UV index >8 can stress cauliflower plants.
max_uv_index.preventive_measure: Provide shade during peak sun.

min_temperature.alert_message: Temperature below 5 °C can delay cabbage germination.
min_temperature.preventive_measure: Plant after last frost and use row covers.

max_temperature.alert_message: Temperature above 30 °C can cause cabbage heads to split.
max_temperature.preventive_measure: Harvest before heat and provide irrigation.

min_humidity.alert_message: Humidity below 50% may stress cabbage.

max_humidity.alert_message: Humidity above 90% raises black rot risk in cabbage.
max_humidity.preventive_measure: Ensure good soil drainage.

min_rainfall.alert_message: Rainfall <10 mm may necessitate irrigation.

max_rainfall.alert_message: Rainfall >60 mm can cause waterlogging in cabbage fields.
max_rainfall.preventive_measure: Ensure raised beds.

max_uv_index.alert_message: UV index >8 can increase heat stress on cabbage.
max_uv_index.preventive_measure: Use shade cloth.

min_temperature.alert_message: Temperature below 15 °C slows brinjal growth.
min_temperature.preventive_measure: Use plastic covers at night.

max_temperature.alert_message: Temperature above 40 °C can cause flower drop in brinjal.
max_temperature.preventive_measure: Provide shade and irrigation.

min_humidity.alert_message: Humidity below 50% can stress eggplants.

max_humidity.alert_message: Humidity above 90% can lead to fungal diseases in eggplant.
max_humidity.preventive_measure: Ensure good airflow.

min_rainfall.alert_message: Rainfall <10 mm requires irrigation for eggplant.

max_rainfall.alert_message: Rainfall >60 mm can cause root rot in eggplant.
max_rainfall.preventive_measure: Use raised beds and good drainage.

max_uv_index.alert_message: UV index >10 may scorch eggplant fruits.
max_uv_index.preventive_measure: Provide partial shade.

min_temperature.alert_message: Temperature below 18 °C slows okra germination.
min_temperature.preventive_measure: Plant in warm season.

max_temperature.alert_message: Temperature above 45 °C causes severe heat stress in okra.
max_temperature.preventive_measure: Mulch heavily and irrigate.

min_humidity.alert_message: Humidity below 40% may cause flower drop in okra.

max_humidity.alert_message: Humidity above 90% increases fungal disease risk in okra.
max_humidity.preventive_measure: Ensure ventilation.

min_rainfall.alert_message: Rainfall <10 mm requires irrigation for okra.

max_rainfall.alert_message: Rainfall >100 mm can waterlog okra fields.
max_rainfall.preventive_measure: Ensure raised beds.

max_uv_index.alert_message: UV index >12 can scorch okra leaves.
max_uv_index.preventive_measure: Use shade cloth.
